race.comment: ACHESON (4) was safely held in the Little Dance, but the wide run without cover makes that result easier to overlook, and his prior head second at Canberra reads well for this. VERMICELLA (1) was sound first-up at Gundagai, beaten just under two lengths after finishing off from the rear, and her record of three wins from five starts at this track gives her a strong platform second-up. BELLEISTIC KIDS (2) comes through metro BM72 and BM88 races, was only beaten just under a length at Canterbury last start, and the 2kg claim helps him stay in the winning mix if he holds that form at 1600m. BLOW IN (5) gets the blinkers back on now and a forward showing is on the cards.
